name: Sigma Survivor
description:
About This Game

Sigma Survivor is a bloody pixel-art game where every chest you come across is a pure lottery. Pick your hero and destroy the hundreds of monsters in your way! All your skills fire on their own, but dodging the attacks is still on you. Dive into a story that's anything but ordinary and roam the lands as a Sigma Survivor!

Fight the horde of monsters!

  • Hundreds of monsters at once, and your job is to make it to the end of the round.
  • Dozens of weapons to choose from, from the classics like lightning to one-of-a-kind weapons like the slot machine.
  • Six different heroes, each with a completely different playstyle.
  • Many worlds and levels, each with its own unique enemies.

Every chest is a pure lottery

  • Open a chest and power up your hero, or take the risk and go for more!
  • Chests hide minigames, and beating one hands your hero extra bonuses. There are dozens of them, so you won't run out of thrills!
  • Win the minigame and you get a better reward than the standard one. Lose it, and well... tough luck!
  • Plenty of other casino twists too, like the slot machine or a quick round with the dealer to power up your character.

Died? Start over. This time stronger!

  • Upgrade your weapons, improve and merge items at the blacksmith, learn the elements, master every hero and make them stronger.
  • A shop full of NPCs, and every one of them has valuable bonuses for your hero.
  • Lots of attractions and secrets hidden across the levels!
  • Plenty of achievements to unlock, and a grimoire that keeps every stat from your games as one big summary.

Quick runs for long hours

  • A standard run takes about 20 minutes.
  • Every setting can be tweaked, so the game plays the way you like it.
short_desc: Sigma Survivor is a roguelike type game. Lead your hero and survive the whole round while enemies of every kind cross your path. Grab power-ups, take risks, play MINIGAMES, upgrade your character, and come back stronger with every run!
